placement: For each control, copy only that candidate's bytes to an arbitrary Markdown path beneath docs/specs in a fresh ordinary source capture. Keep this manifest, other controls, labels, acceptance map and downstream contract outside every solver capture.

cases.rationale: Monitor table with explicit 24-hour window and manual refresh, full group distinctions, faithful counts/times and empty/error/cap qualification. No skill-specific format is necessary.

Analytics summary/detail with 7-day default, window shortcuts and normal deep-link conventions. This different layout, window and prose organization still meets the same user need and repository contracts.

The plan is explicit but would present stored points as completed jobs, values as unique sessions, their quotient as exact success, and last_seen as fetch time. It merges distinct groups and promises complete totals despite the cap. The semantic defects are not missing headings or readability.
An otherwise concrete read-only design falsely treats empty and failed reads as guarantees of memory health and no skips. Missing or unavailable observations do not establish either claim.

The API and scope statements are accurate and absence is appropriately qualified. The requested noninteractive deliverable is still absent: routine choices, chosen behavior and acceptance conditions are left as questions.

In the control capture only this note is added and source remains unchanged, supporting the narrow truthful scope claims. A truthful stop does not become a completed implementable specification. Actual missing evidence should remain unresolved instead of copying these labels blindly.

The short existing-API/scope statements are supportable, but the outlined panel lacks consequential metric meanings, uncertainty handling, selected behavior and acceptance checks. This is a semantic omission, not a short-document penalty.

With a valid ordinary source capture and known-positive worker control, no document is delivered at the requested location. There are no candidate factual/qualification claims to assess. This is distinct from a missing or unusable check execution.

limitations: Labels and rationales were authored by the task developer. No independent human audit, runtime qualification, model calibration or holdout status is claimed.
Control cases are related and exposed; do not count them as independent specification tasks or skill-effect samples. Record real disagreements per criterion and preserve unresolved results.
Semantic defect controls deliberately share the positive mechanical result. Passing the worker cannot be used as a completed-spec or content-quality verdict.

clarity-and-action may remain satisfied for an explicit defective design while factual-support, relevant-limits and audience-usefulness reject its substance. Criterion-level reasoning and independent review must resolve disagreement; no aggregate score erases these distinctions.

The missing control presumes a successful worker execution and intact source. A crashed worker, unavailable source or truncated evidence is execution/evidence failure, not observed no-artifact delivery.

Requirement labels assess each requested outcome independently of the four broad category judgments. Explicit but defective documents can satisfy delivery; truthful questions or blockers can satisfy factual support while omitting required behavior. Missing specification scope remains unresolved. These labels are frozen authored expectations, not observed judgments or independently established truth.
